tag.name: CloudWatch Metrics
tag.description: Bounded local raw custom Metrics: three Query/XML actions; no alarms, automatic AWS delivery or full CloudWatch claim. Native data and responses require actual local state/permission.

descriptionAppend:
**CloudWatch Metrics — bounded native Query/XML:** select application/x-www-form-urlencoded, X-Simulator-Service: monitoring and X-Simulator-Region: us-east-1 (or another listed local Region). CLEAR X-Amz-Target and any stale Authorization value from a previous service before Send; alternatively use a dummy TCSIM SigV4 scope for service monitoring whose Region agrees. Example selection does not change headers automatically. Keep the signed-in local session or host-issued X-Simulator-Token; routing/signature metadata is not authentication. The selected exercise identity needs exact cloudwatch:PutMetricData, cloudwatch:ListMetrics or cloudwatch:GetMetricStatistics on Resource *. Operator credentials do not bypass a selected reader's policy; explicit Deny wins.

Version2010-08-01; only PutMetricData, ListMetrics, GetMetricStatistics. Put raw Value only,1–1000 records/30 dimensions, optional standard StorageResolution60, finite bounded values (zero/negative supported), timestamp14days past through2hours future. Omitted Timestamp uses trusted current time. List up to500/page with10 subset dimension filters and opaque NextToken; immediate local visibility only for series ingested within14days and having a point retained within15days of the captured page time. This discovery window differs from raw-sample retention. GetMetricStatistics requires exact complete dimensions, basic SampleCount/Sum/Minimum/Maximum/Average, minute-rounded inclusive start/exclusive end, period multiple60 and at most1440 requested buckets. Omitted Unit preserves separate recorded-unit streams; no conversion or invented zero for missing data.

Static examples are documentation, not live saved values. Put publishes one sample in Simulator/Reference. Replace REPLACE_START_TIME_RFC3339 and REPLACE_END_TIME_RFC3339 with a recent UTC/offset time window before Send. Unsubstituted placeholders are invalid400. Result XML examples and RequestId are illustrative, not current state.

Physical wire and expanded Query bodies each have a local1MiB inclusive cap, output2MiB. One gzip member accepted; malformed/truncated/CRC-invalid/concatenated/trailing data and other encodings fail. Go1.26's10000 raw form-token guard also applies. These are explicit local bounds, not a proof of AWS decompression behavior. Native XML errors include400 MissingParameter/InvalidParameterValue/InvalidParameterCombination/SimulatorQuotaExceeded,403 AccessDenied,404 UnknownOperationException,413 RequestEntityTooLargeException and500 InternalServiceError. Outer local Access401 can be JSON before native Query parsing.

Local15day raw retention/no AWS long-term rollups; reads never GC. Only an authorized committed Put can atomically collect strictly expired rows in its own Region/namespace; peer expired rows still consume physical budget. Default simulator budgets1000series/100000samples/64MiB logical payload/64Regions, not AWS quotas. Continuation binds Region/options/revision/asOf/position, expires1hour, survives sameDB restart, and becomes stale after a successful Put in that Region.

Unsupported: JSON/X-Amz-Target Metrics transport (current AWS docs also show JSON; this pinned local slice uses Query), Values/Counts arrays, statistic sets, entities, high resolution, AWS/ namespace emission, linked-account filters, RecentlyActive, GetMetricData/Insights, percentiles, metric math, alarms, automatic service delivery, rollups, CloudFormation Metrics or DeleteMetric. The actual41-call original-SDK acceptance uses two regular local CLIs/Access/native IAM/default compression; it is not full AWS/Google-cloud compatibility or authenticated cloud-console parity. Served Scalar/reference acceptance on this source is still pending; capability verification flags are not changed here.
serviceDescriptionAppend: Metrics uses monitoring with Query Version2010-08-01; clear X-Amz-Target. This selects a protocol only and grants no authority.

^MetricData\\.member\\.(?:[1-9][0-9]{0,2.description: RFC3339 timestamp,14days past through2hours future; omit for trusted current time.

CloudWatchPutMetricDataQuery.description: Flat native Query fields. Contiguous member indexes, complete dimension pairs, finite values, Unicode/control rules, current time windows and cross-field constraints remain authoritative native checks; this schema is not their proof.

CloudWatchListMetricsQuery.description: Flat native Query fields. Contiguous member indexes, complete dimension pairs, finite values, Unicode/control rules, current time windows and cross-field constraints remain authoritative native checks; this schema is not their proof.

StartTime.description: Replace REPLACE_START_TIME_RFC3339 with recent UTC time; native start rounds down to minute.

EndTime.description: Replace REPLACE_END_TIME_RFC3339 with later exclusive UTC time.

CloudWatchGetMetricStatisticsQuery.description: Flat native Query fields. Contiguous member indexes, complete dimension pairs, finite values, Unicode/control rules, current time windows and cross-field constraints remain authoritative native checks; this schema is not their proof.
